name: Purple The Adventurous Fruit
storyline: Many years ago, two unknown galactic entities fought a deadly battle, in which both were knocked out and transformed into comets that collided with a small planet called "Three Spikes Planet." Years later, evil entities called "darks" began to contaminate the planet, but two beings end up awakening from the ground, and our hero Purple is one of them!
summary: Purple The Adventurous Fruit is a retro-style 2D platform game where you control Purple, an anthropomorphic grape, who must defeat various threats, from robots to terrifying dark creatures.
